name: unreal-editor-skills-for-codex
description: Execute and verify live Unreal Editor work through Codex-ready MCP workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Unreal Editor safely through MCP toolsets.
interface.longDescription: Adds an execution layer for live Unreal Editor control, MCP toolset authoring, project-owned environment operations, persistent-camera evidence, independent read-only review handoff, dependency-free production contracts, project-specific Unreal Agent Skills, and optional consent-based local usage metrics. It can consume designs from the separately installable Unreal Development Handbook for Codex and remains usable without it.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the open level or verify a marketplace import without disturbing it.
Design an AI-callable Unreal toolset with tests.
Apply an approved environment design and verify it with persistent-camera evidence.
Ground a building on sloped terrain by checking all four base corners.
